trials.claimQuote:
Lifetime access to Power Formulas
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
- All future Unlimited Plan updates
trials.reasoning: A reviewer confirms the purchase is a lifetime deal with no subscriptions. The prosecution's generic website disclaimer about availability and keeping website material up to date does not directly cancel the lifetime product access.

exhibits.quote: warrant its completeness or accuracy; nor do we commit to ensuring that the website remains
exhibits.argument: Vendor disclaims accuracy and commitment to remain, undermining promise of lifetime access and future updates.

exhibits.quote: available or that the material on the website is kept up to date.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states it will not ensure availability or updates, contradicting lifetime access with all future updates.

exhibits.quote: You get a lifetime deal, so no pesky subscriptions to deal with!
exhibits.argument: Reviewer confirms the purchase is a lifetime deal without subscriptions.

trials.claimQuote:
Unlimited formula refreshes
- Schedule hourly/daily data refreshes
- Access to all formulas
- Formula Builder
- Live email and chat support
trials.reasoning: The vendor's pricing directly lists unlimited formula refreshes with hourly/daily scheduling. Third-party fees and a storage-quota message do not show a limit on the number of refreshes.

exhibits.quote: Third-party services fees are not included. For example, if you use the AI formula, you will
exhibits.argument: Refreshes require paid third-party services, so formula refreshes are not truly unlimited at no cost.

exhibits.argument: Buyer hit a storage quota that blocks use, contradicting claim of unlimited refreshes.

exhibits.quote:
- Unlimited formula refreshes

- Schedule hourly/daily data refreshes

- Access to all formulas (AI, AI_IMAGE, AI_VISION)
exhibits.argument: Vendor pricing lists unlimited refreshes, scheduled refreshes and access to all formulas.

trials.claimQuote:
Live email and chat support
- Unlimited article generation using GPT-4
- Unlimited image generation using Dall-E
- Add your own OpenAI key for unlimited usage
trials.reasoning: A reviewer confirms no limit on GPT-3 or GPT-4 use with the lifetime purchase. Advice to process about 10 items at a time is a batching tip, not a total generation cap.

exhibits.argument: Users must pay all OpenAI costs themselves, so article generation is not unlimited and included.

exhibits.argument: Buyer reports generation must be limited to small batches, undermining unlimited generation claim.

exhibits.quote: for $39 lifetime, you have no limit : GPT3 or GPT4, up to you, and not only AI formulas, also API / SQL.
